steps.title: Read the enquiry
steps.role: Sales · needs thread:read
steps.summary: Nothing in the inbox creates a customer. Copy the sender's company name, email and signature details, then go to step 2 (Sales → Companies).

steps.title: Create the customer
steps.role: Sales · needs customer:read to see the directory, and create rights to add
steps.summary: You are on the company record page. Scroll to the Contacts card for step 3, or go straight to Sales → Quotations for step 5.

steps.title: Record the person who called
steps.role: Sales
steps.summary: The contact is on file. Next is step 5 (raise the quotation). If this customer needs its own rate card, do step 4 first.

steps.title: Publish the rate card
steps.role: Sales admin builds the card; a reviewer approves it · needs quotation.feeTemplate.create / .update to build, .review to decide
steps.summary: Once approved, the card shows in the quotation's Reference Template picker (step 6) and sets the price floor enforced at step 7.

steps.title: Raise the quotation
steps.role: Sales · needs quotation:read + create
steps.summary: The quotation is saved with a number but no prices. Go straight on to step 6 in the Fee Details card on the same page.

steps.title: Price it
steps.role: Sales
steps.summary: The applied lines are already stored on a saved quotation; anything you typed by hand is not. Press Save Quote — that is step 7.

steps.title: Save against the tariff floor
steps.role: Sales
steps.summary: The quotation is saved and within tariff. Next is step 8: submit it for review.

steps.title: Get it approved
steps.role: Sales submits; a reviewer holding audit:read decides, routed by the open audit stage (the nav entry itself needs quotation:read)
steps.summary: Approved: the Convert to order button unlocks (step 11), and you can send it (step 9). Rejected: fix it and Resubmit.

steps.title: Send it to the customer
steps.role: Sales
steps.summary: The reply lands in the linked thread (see the Threads card on the quotation, or Inbox). When the customer answers, do step 10.

steps.title: Record their answer
steps.role: Sales
steps.summary: Won → step 11 (Convert to order). Lost → the chain ends here.

steps.title: Convert the won quote into a job
steps.role: Sales · needs quotation convert rights
steps.summary: You are on /order//edit. Go straight to step 12 and press Assign number.

steps.title: Stamp the job number by hand
steps.role: Sales, immediately after converting · needs collectiveOrder write
steps.summary: The order has its identity. Continue with step 14 on the same form, or let operations pick it up at step 13.

steps.title: Receive it into operations
steps.role: Operations · needs collectiveOrder:read to see the queue, plus collectiveOrder.receive / collectiveOrder.reject to decide
steps.summary: A received order is operations' to run. Open it from its trade ledger for step 14.

steps.title: Fill in the operational detail
steps.role: Operations · needs collectiveOrder write
steps.summary: You land on the trade ledger. Submit the order for review — step 15.

steps.title: Get the order approved
steps.role: Operations submits; a reviewer holding audit:read decides (the /approve/order nav entry carries no permission of its own)
steps.summary: An approved order is ready to run. Phase D starts with the bill of lading — step 16.

steps.title: Raise the bill of lading
steps.role: Documentation · needs lading:read plus create rights
steps.summary: The B/L exists. Move it through its states — step 17.

steps.title: Move the B/L through its states
steps.role: Documentation · needs lading:read plus the gate for each verb
steps.summary: The bill is moving. In parallel, the carrier's MBL/HBL goes through step 18.

steps.title: Approve the carrier's MBL/HBL
steps.role: Documentation · needs document:read plus review rights to approve
steps.summary: Approval starts the tracking clock. Watch it at step 19.

steps.title: Watch the demurrage clock
steps.role: Operations · needs bl-job:read to watch the board, and bl-job:void to void a job
steps.summary: Demurrage is under watch. The money side starts at step 20.

steps.title: Enter what the job cost and what it bills
steps.role: Operator with collectiveOrder:read to open the order and collectiveOrder.update to save (saveChildren requires COLLECTIVE_ORDER.update).
steps.summary: Stay on Expense Entry with saved rows. Next: step 21, submit the fees for Cost review from Money > Cost lines.

steps.title: Get the fees reviewed
steps.role: Submitter: expense:read to see the ledger, plus audit.read and expense.costLine.update to submit. Reviewer: audit.read and expense.costLine.review, and must be a routed reviewer on the open stage (seeded Cost review flow routes to the accounting role, any-pass).
steps.summary: Approved lines drop out of the reviewer's queue. Next: step 22, bill them from Money > Cost lines > Create Bill.

steps.title: Group the fees into a bill
steps.role: expense:read to open; expense.bill.create to create bills.
steps.summary: Bills appear under Money > Bills (Bill Management). Next: step 23, submit each bill for Bill review.

steps.title: Get the bill approved
steps.role: Submitter: audit.read and expense.bill.update. Reviewer: audit.read and expense.bill.review and a routed reviewer. Seeded Bill review flow: stage 1 accounting (all must pass, any reject), stage 2 director (any one).
steps.summary: Once the latest review passes, invoicing and write-off are unfrozen. Next: step 24, Invoicing from Money > Bills.

steps.title: Issue the invoice
steps.role: expense:read to open; expense.invoice.create to issue.
steps.summary: Invoice appears under Money > Invoices (Invoice Record). Next: step 25, preview and download it.

steps.title: Produce and hand over the document
steps.role: Accounting · the sidebar item needs expense:read, but the list itself gates on expense.invoice.read; expense.invoice.update for the Downloaded/Printed marks, expense.invoice.cancel to cancel.
steps.summary: Customer has the invoice document. Next: step 26, record the receipt under Money > Payments.

steps.title: Record the money and settle it
steps.role: Cashier / Accounting · the sidebar item needs expense:read, but the lists gate on expense.payment.read and expense.writeOff.read; expense.payment.create to record, expense.writeOff.verify to verify, expense.writeOff.reverse to void, expense.payment.delete to delete an unsettled payment.
steps.summary: The bill is settled — done on the normal path, since step 24 invoiced it. Next: step 27, the month-end exports.

steps.title: Close the month
steps.role: Export documents: expense.costLine.read. Financial Stat: report:read to view, report:export for Month-end pack and Excel/PDF.
steps.summary: Statement / debit note / profit sheets and the month-end workbook are downloaded for the customer and bookkeeper. End of the intake SOP.
